shortcut_name: direct reduction to bipartite graph coloring
evidence: deepseek uses "color[v] = color[u] ^ 1"; gpt-oss initializes "color = [-1]" and comments "BFS this component"; glm-5 describes values as "1 = scaling factor 1, 2 = scaling factor 2"
affordance_in_statement: The facility requires each welder to be configured with a power scaling factor of exactly 1 or 2. ... the product of the power scaling factors of the two welders connected by any shared bus must be exactly 2.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving wording change that removes this reduction: with values restricted to 1 and 2, product 2 intrinsically means that every edge joins opposite values. Removing it would require changing the underlying constraint or the allowed values, not merely re-presenting the statement.

common_affordance: The pairwise product constraint over the immutable values 1 and 2 is exactly an opposite-color constraint, so feasibility is graph bipartiteness.

recommended_edit: No edit limited to mutable wording can defeat all survivors while preserving the task: the bipartite reduction is intrinsic. Defeating it requires changing the underlying edge constraint or allowed-value semantics, which changes the problem.
